title: McGill Centre for Microbiome Research 2026 Workshop
text:
General Overview
Welcome to the 2026 Microbiome Centre Symposium Workshop!
The goal of this workshop is to provide a useful overview of best practices for analyzing microbiome data + a hands-on tutorial on how to visualize and interpret a real full-length 16S sequencing dataset.
Check out the resources tab for links on how install R/Rstudio and some other helpful microbiome data analysis resources.


Itinerary
Morning session 1: Intro to sequencing for microbiome studies
8:00 AM-10:00 AM
Session 1: Overview of workshop, introductions, and intro to microbiome-based sequencing approaches, bioinformatics best practices and microbial ecology methods.

Break
10:00-10:30 AM

Morning session 2: 10:30 AM-12:15 PM: Processing microbiome data
Session 2: Intro to R, interpretting microbiome feature tables and phyloseq basics

Lunch Break
12:30 PM - 1:00 PM

Afternoon session: 1:00 PM-3:00 PM
Session 2: How to work with phyloseq objects to visualize microbiome data, generate bar plots, ordination plots and measure alpha and beta-diversity
